column1: # mbw normalization ceilings that differ from the audited ceiling of the host.
# bench/intp_metrics.py rescales the mbw median of every matching run by
# used_mbps / reference_mbps, so cells measured against different ceilings
# become comparable. Runs whose run.json records mbw_ceiling_bps are never
# rescaled. Set INTP_MBW_RAW=1 to reproduce the uncorrected values.
# reference_mbps, note. Times are ISO 8601 with offset.
